# Dillon Simeone

> Lead Design Engineer & Hardware Artisan based in Oregon specializing in accessibility, Deaf-led hardware, haptic technology, embedded systems, and creative fabrication. Available for custom hardware commissions (invoiced via Square, with local Oregon installation available).

## About

Dillon Simeone is a Deaf technologist, maker, developer, and interface designer with over a decade of experience turning ideas into physical hardware: custom stage hardware, interactive installations, accessible alert systems, wearable haptics, and rapid embedded prototypes.

- **Website:** https://dillonsimeone.com/
- **Email:** dillonsimeone@gmail.com
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/DillonSimeone
- **LinkedIn:** https://linkedin.com/in/dillonsimeone
- **Google Scholar:** https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=bgwjaP0AAAAJ
- **YouTube:** https://www.youtube.com/@Dillonsimeone/shorts
- **Resume:** https://docs.google.com/document/d/17at4VC7BOsuEL0SFwjbOCelqJ94owcdG1yyveG8QO0Y/edit?usp=sharing

## Affiliations & Recognition

- **Universal Music Design / CymaSpace:** Lead Design Engineer building assistive music technology, wearable haptics, and audio-reactive LED visuals.
- **PDX Makerspace (control+H):** Member and hardware builder.
- **Oregon Community Foundation Creative Heights Award ($96,000):** Awarded for *Feel the Difference: A Haptic Petting Zoo* (featured at Crowd Supply Teardown 2026 in Portland, OR).

## Flagship & Featured Projects

- [Haptic Petting Zoo](https://dillonsimeone.com/Projects/HapticPettingZoo/index.html): Touring interactive installation translating acoustic frequencies and spatial resonance into tactile vibrations felt through skin and bone.
- [Motion-Reactive Haptic Light Baton](https://dillonsimeone.com/Projects/LightBaton/index.html): Kinetic performance instrument with 6-axis MPU6050 IMU motion tracking, sub-millisecond broadcast latency, and haptic feedback.
- **GeLu (GestoLumina) Bracers:** Research-grade wearable haptic interface for gesture input, fingertip haptics, and audio-reactive lighting designed for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing community.
- **PULSE: Haptic Ecosystem:** Hardware and software framework for tactile feedback using an ESP32 Leader unit and durable Haptic Saucers.
- **Deaf Ringbell Detector:** Non-invasive acoustic ESP-NOW visual alert system that detects existing doorbells for Deaf/HoH accessibility.
- **Haxel Telemetry Engine:** Unified Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) and captive portal for LRAs, ERMs, and solenoid drivers with dynamic back-EMF telemetry.
- **Ember Bytecode VM:** Stack-based bytecode virtual machine and Pratt compiler for real-time LED pattern generation on the ESP32-C3.
- **CH32V003 RISC-V Haptic Core:** Field guide and production build log for WCH's 10-cent 32-bit RISC-V microcontroller driving haptic hardware.
- **Sound-Reactive LED Hypercube:** Five 8x8 WS2812B matrix panels (320 LEDs) engineered for organic, sound-reactive 3D ripples.
